fidelity: F2a -- Point Reactor Kinetics + Lumped Thermal-Hydraulics with Reactivity Feedback
source: Duderstadt & Hamilton (1976), Nuclear Reactor Analysis, Wiley; Lamarsh & Baratta (2001), Introduction to Nuclear Reactor Theory / Nuclear Reactor Engineering, 3rd ed.; Todreas & Kazimi (2012), Nuclear Systems, 2nd ed., CRC Press

unit.name: Generic 3300 MWth / 1100 MWe BWR (BWR/6 class), point-kinetics representation

Lambda.note: Prompt neutron generation time (thermal LWR ~ 1e-5..1e-4 s; Duderstadt & Hamilton 1976)

beta_total.note: Total delayed neutron fraction for U-235 (~0.0065; Lamarsh & Baratta 2001 Table)

beta_fractions.note: 6-group delayed-neutron fractions, U-235 thermal fission (Keepin / Duderstadt & Hamilton 1976)

lambda_decay.note: 6-group delayed-neutron precursor decay constants, U-235 (Keepin; Duderstadt & Hamilton 1976)

alpha_doppler.note: Doppler (fuel temperature) reactivity coefficient, negative (U-238 resonance broadening); Lamarsh & Baratta 2001

alpha_void.note: Void reactivity coefficient dk/k per unit core-average void fraction; strongly negative in a BWR (Todreas & Kazimi 2012)

T_fuel_ref_k.note: Reference fuel temperature for Doppler feedback (full-power average)

T_coolant_ref_k.note: Reference coolant/saturation temperature (~286 degC at 70 bar)

alpha_void_ref.note: Reference core-average void fraction at full power (BWR typical 0.4)

m_fuel_kg.note: Total UO2 fuel mass in core (~150 t for a 3300 MWth core)

cp_fuel.note: UO2 specific heat at operating temperature (Todreas & Kazimi 2012)

m_coolant_kg.note: Effective coolant/moderator mass in active core inventory

cp_coolant.note: Effective water specific heat near saturation at 70 bar

hA_fuel_coolant.note: Fuel-to-coolant heat-transfer conductance (UA), core lumped; sized for full-power fuel-coolant DeltaT ~ 540 K

W_cool.note: Coolant-to-saturation-sink conductance; large because heat is removed as latent boiling at near-constant saturation temperature -> coolant stays ~2 K above sink at full power

T_sink_k.note: Saturation heat-sink reference (pressure-controlled, ~286 degC at 70 bar)

h_fg_jkg.note: Latent heat of vaporization at 70 bar (Todreas & Kazimi 2012)

void_gain.note: Steady-state void response gain mapping boiling power to core-average void

reactivity_dollars.note: Inserted reactivity in dollars (must stay below prompt critical = 1$)
